Ritika Mishra
Frontend Engineer | Kolkata
ritika.mishra705@example.com | +91 9331048965 | 60 days notice

Experienced frontend engineer focused on building performant, accessible web applications for healthcare workflows. Strong background in component-driven development, testing, and optimizing delivery pipelines to improve user experience and reduce release friction. Comfortable working in Agile teams and documenting solutions for cross-functional stakeholders.

Experience
Medisure — Sep 2025 - Present
Frontend Engineer, Remote
- Implemented a modular React component library in TypeScript and Tailwind CSS used across patient-facing and clinician dashboards, reducing UI duplication by 45% and accelerating feature delivery.
- Led adoption of Jest-based unit testing and Cypress end-to-end checks, increasing CI pass rate from 78% to 96% and catching regressions before production releases.
- Optimized Webpack builds and NextJS route-level code-splitting to cut first contentful paint by 32% on key pages, improving perceived performance for low-bandwidth users.
- Collaborated with designers and product managers in Agile ceremonies and documented patterns and release notes in Confluence to streamline handoffs.

Projects
- Internal Design Tokens Migration — migrated legacy CSS to Tailwind CSS utility tokens and standardized TypeScript types for theme values, reducing visual regressions and simplifying component theming.
- Patient Intake Flow Revamp — rebuilt a multi-step intake form using NextJS and ReactJS with progressive validation and offline resilience on Linux-based test environments; decreased average form completion time by 20%.
